_comment: Committed settings for a Design Context Kit workspace. Loaded when THIS folder is the project root — which is why CLAUDE.md §0 tells the designer to open Claude on the workspace folder, not the folder above it. Two jobs. (1) ALLOW: the kit's recurring local, no-network operations run without a prompt, so a describe run or a wireframe round isn't a stream of approval cards. Deliberately NOT allowed: tools/capture.js (the one command that reaches the designer's product — its visible, per-action consent is the kit's trust story, not friction to remove), tools/login.js (opens the password window), and the one-time npm/npx installs (pre-briefed in INSTALL.md, and on a first run the agent is usually still one level up, so a project rule wouldn't apply anyway). (2) DENY: hard-enforces CLAUDE.md hard rule 1 — the captured library is FACT and no file-editing tool may touch it. CLAUDE.md can only ask; a deny rule enforces. Note deny is evaluated BEFORE allow and cannot carry exceptions, so the sanctioned describe-step exception (page.md) and the designer-owned annotations.json are simply absent from the list rather than allowed back. Regeneration still works: deny covers Claude's file tools and file-ish Bash (cat/sed/…), NOT node subprocesses, so `node tools/build-index.js` rewrites registry.json/INDEX.md/tokens.json/dashboard.html/thumb.png and `node tools/capture.js` rewrites page snapshots exactly as before. thumb.png is listed for the same reason registry.json is: it is a DERIVED view (a deterministic downscale of screenshot.png, written by build-index.js or capture.js — see tools/thumb.js), and a hand-edited derived view is a lie that survives until the next rebuild. Rules use Edit(...) only — Claude Code accepts Write(...)/NotebookEdit(...) path rules but never consults them, and warns at startup; Edit rules cover every file-editing tool. Paths use a leading / so they anchor at this workspace root instead of matching a design-context directory at any depth.
